review_note: Gamma (log), iid group (1 | g) plus animal(A), animal(Ainv) or phylo, with SD regressions on BOTH fields (sd(g) ~ zg, sd(p) ~ zp). The three rows are each exercised by a fit with SDs on both providers, which closes the earlier criterion 3 failure of the ordinary-SD-only parent. The oracle is a base-R dense Laplace, independent of the package. A is Henderson (inbred pedigree), phylo K is ape::vcv divided by tree height with a check that the unscaled vcv differs, and levels are shuffled. logLik tolerance 1e-4. Bugs (swapped selectors, reversed SDs, cov2cor(A) or raw vcv, K by position) each move it by more than 0.1 and pass. This also supplies the ape::vcv kernel independence the parent lacked for the phylo row. Manifest 7/7 match, and the rerun shows 44 expectations, 0 failures, 0 skips. Does NOT establish: calibration or coverage, Julia parity, a modelled-sigma Gamma, or other providers or families.
